title: explore/overlay.json: module-explorer's judgments (D-052). scripts/explore.mjs checks every id and citation in it.

items.description: Frontier items not explored, keyed by FR id. The agent's reasons only: destructive-preexisting, guard-denied and unreachable cite the capture that shows why; duplicate-of names an item with the same role and name. not-allowed-in-mode, out-of-module, external, logout and disabled are derived by the script only.

detail.description: Why; for duplicate-of, the other item's FR id.

citation.description: destructive-preexisting, guard-denied, unreachable: a capture that names this control, or a different state that acting on it reached.

kq.description: Knowledge open points, keyed by KQ id.

state.description: observed: the state that shows the answer.

evidence.description: observed: a file under the module.

reason.description: dismissed: why it needs no answer.

citation.description: dismissed: a file that quotes three consecutive words of the open point (not its own knowledge file), or an answered clarification row a question linked to this KQ.

inputs.description: Untried inputs with a reason instead of a question, keyed by FR id.

prefixes.description: Extra route prefixes that belong to the module.
